verdict.rationale: SerpApi's own `output=md` mode returns results as markdown "optimized for LLMs and AI agents" at "roughly half the tokens". A field-selection parameter can also shrink payloads, and SerpApi markets the API for RAG, so the sizing half of the story is documented. Nothing shows results ranked or chunked for LLM context: results keep the search engine's native order, with no relevance re-ranking, token-budget or snippet-length controls. Missing for 10: LLM-oriented relevance ranking or re-ranking, explicit token-budget or chunk-size controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG-ready output quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get results sized and ranked for direct use as LLM context in a RAG pipeline

citations.quote: `md` to get a markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents
Serve any SerpApi search result as clean markdown. Same data as JSON, zero configuration, roughly half the tokens. Works with every API.
Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Feed search data into AI pipelines to minimize hallucinations.
